# Free Home Printables

> Free printable meal planner, cleaning checklist, chore chart, habit tracker, 52-week savings challenge, monthly budget planner, 2027 calendar, wall art prints, Christmas gift tags, Christmas coloring pages, daily planner, weekly planner, Christmas word search, bill tracker, alphabet tracing worksheets, recipe cards, and Christmas activity pack. Every download is free, with no sign-up and no email.

## Printables

- [Meal Planner](https://freehomeprintables.com/meal-planner.html): A weekly meal planner with breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks for all seven days, plus a grocery list on the same page.
- [Cleaning Checklist](https://freehomeprintables.com/cleaning-checklist.html): Daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning tasks with checkboxes.
- [Chore Chart](https://freehomeprintables.com/chore-chart.html): One row per person, one box per day — everyone can see who does what, all week long.
- [Habit Tracker](https://freehomeprintables.com/habit-tracker.html): A monthly grid for up to eight habits. Check off each day you do it.
- [52-Week Savings Challenge](https://freehomeprintables.com/savings-challenge.html): Save $1 in week 1, $2 in week 2, and $1,378 by week 52. One page, one checkbox per week.
- [Monthly Budget Planner](https://freehomeprintables.com/budget-planner.html): Write your income, plan each bill and expense, then track what you actually spent. Planned vs actual, one page.
- [2027 Calendar](https://freehomeprintables.com/calendar-2027.html): The whole year at a glance, plus one full month per page, with US federal holidays marked in red.
- [Wall Art](https://freehomeprintables.com/wall-art.html): Fourteen free printable wall art prints — surf watercolors, eucalyptus botanicals, watercolor landscapes, a Lake Natron flamingo oil painting, and inspirational quotes in fancy script. High-resolution JPG files at 300 DPI.
- [Christmas Gift Tags](https://freehomeprintables.com/gift-tags.html): Eight free printable Christmas gift tags on one page, in four designs — a Christmas tree, an ornament, a snowflake, and a star — each with To and From lines.
- [Christmas Coloring Pages](https://freehomeprintables.com/coloring-pages.html): Six free printable Christmas coloring pages for kids — Santa Claus, a reindeer, a Christmas tree, a snowman, presents, and a Christmas stocking. Bold outlines, one picture per page.
- [Christmas Coloring Pages — 20 Pictures](https://freehomeprintables.com/christmas-coloring-pages.html): A free printable Christmas coloring book with 20 Christmas pictures to color — trees, villages, Santa, snowmen, and more. 20 pages, letter size.
- [Daily Planner](https://freehomeprintables.com/daily-planner.html): A free printable daily planner with an hourly schedule from 7 AM to 8 PM, a top 3 priorities list, a to-do checklist, and notes. One page, undated.
- [Weekly Planner](https://freehomeprintables.com/weekly-planner.html): A free printable weekly planner with a row for every day from Monday to Sunday, plus a priorities box. Undated, for any week.
- [Bill Tracker](https://freehomeprintables.com/bill-tracker.html): A free printable bill tracker with room for 12 monthly bills, a total-due line, and a debt payoff section.
- [Alphabet Tracing](https://freehomeprintables.com/alphabet-tracing.html): Free printable alphabet tracing worksheets for kids — all 26 letters, uppercase and lowercase, in light grey to trace over.
- [Recipe Cards](https://freehomeprintables.com/recipe-cards.html): Free printable recipe cards, four per page to cut out and keep, plus a kitchen conversion chart with volume, weight, and oven temperatures.
- [Christmas Gift List](https://freehomeprintables.com/christmas-gift-list.html): A free printable Christmas gift list with room for 12 gifts — who it is for, the gift idea, the budget, and bought and wrapped checkboxes.
- [Christmas Countdown Calendar](https://freehomeprintables.com/christmas-countdown.html): A free printable Christmas countdown calendar with 25 boxes for December 1 to 25, each with a fun holiday activity to do that day.
- [Christmas Scavenger Hunt](https://freehomeprintables.com/christmas-scavenger-hunt.html): A free printable Christmas scavenger hunt with 20 holiday things to find — a candy cane, a stocking, a star, a snowman, and more — with checkboxes and a score line.
- [Christmas Budget Tracker](https://freehomeprintables.com/christmas-budget.html): A free printable Christmas budget tracker with five spending categories — gifts, food, decorations, travel, and cards — plus budget, spent, and left columns and a total line.
- [Christmas Dinner Menu Planner](https://freehomeprintables.com/christmas-menu-planner.html): A free printable Christmas dinner menu planner with space for every course — starter, main, sides, dessert, and drinks — plus who brings what and a shopping list.

## Custom work (paid, on Etsy)

- [Custom Downloads](https://freehomeprintables.com/custom-downloads.html): 20 made-to-order downloads — personalized word searches, crosswords, Sudoku books, coloring pages, planners, spreadsheets and more — from $5, ordered on our Etsy shop, most sent within 24 hours. The printables on this site are free; custom work is paid.

## Key facts

- Every printable on this site is free. No sign-up, no email, no catch.
- All PDFs are letter size and print at home.
- Print as many copies as you like for your own home.
